title: 第591章 终极之战第590章 七魂归一陈景言悲痛欲绝
content_zh:
陈景言没有流泪。
他知道，流泪是对她们以命相托的亵渎。
他闭目凝神，任由星火焚尽旧我之躯、旧我之心、旧我之念。
当最后一缕青莲气息没入心脉，他缓缓睁眼——眸中已无悲喜，唯有一片澄明如初的青莲净火，清净无染，照彻三千世界。
七个女人的全部修为、道果、愿力尽数融入他的体内。
经脉如琉璃淬火，通透坚韧；骨骼似古玉重生，坚不可摧；识海深处。
青莲台静静悬浮，莲心一点，映照三千世界。
每一片莲瓣皆凝聚着她们未竟的道痕与未熄的愿力，成为他新生之基。
陈景言缓缓站起，目光如炬，怒视鸿钧，周身青莲净火无声燃烧，天地为之肃穆。
鸿钧微微一笑，语气平静却带着不容置疑的威严：“我曾多次劝你，带着你的女人离开此界，远离这场注定的劫数。你偏要逆天而行，执迷不悟。如今七魄归一，你终于成了真正的‘执棋者’，但也彻底断了自己的退路。现在，你想走，也走不了了。”
陈景言沉默片刻，声音低沉却坚定如铁：“你想杀了我？”
“是你自不量力，非要自寻死路。”鸿钧的声音低沉而冰冷，仿佛自亘古深渊中传来，带着不容置疑的威严与审判意味。
话音尚未完全落下，陈景言脚下已然升起一轮恢弘壮丽的金红大日轮，炽烈光芒如潮水般奔涌而出，瞬间照亮了整片崩塌的天穹。
那轮盘缓缓旋转，边缘处七瓣莲影次第铺展，层层叠叠，宛如时光回溯中绽放的圣洁之花。
每一瓣莲影都牵引着一道她们生前凝聚至极致的剑意——那是七位女子以命相搏、以魂铸剑所留下的不灭意志。
暖金色的光辉如春日初阳，温柔却坚定地漫过早已支离破碎的时空裂隙，将虚空中残存的寒意与死寂一一驱散。
那些原本倒悬于九天之上、象征天道禁锢的噤声钟，在这股浩然光华的照耀下，竟如冰雪遇火般寸寸熔化，化作滚烫的铜水，顺着天道法则撕裂出的缝隙汩汩流淌，最终汇入无垠虚无之中，仿佛连天地秩序本身也在悄然瓦解。
陈景言缓缓抬起右掌，动作从容却蕴含万钧之力。
随着他掌势轻推，那轮金红大日轮随之向前滚动，掌影在虚空之中不断膨胀、延展，最终遮蔽半边苍穹，将整个天幕染成一片温暖而肃穆的金红色。
掌风所过之处，那些尚悬浮于空中的碎星残骸竟纷纷重新点亮，每一点微光之中，都映照出一位女子昔日笑靥如花的模样——那是她们未竟的愿望，亦是此刻支撑陈景言逆天而行的全部理由。

“她们不是逆天，”陈景言声音平静却字字如铁，“而是要讨还一个迟来了千年的公道。旧天早已腐朽不堪，早就该碎了。而你——这守墓人，也该随着那早已死去的旧秩序一同埋葬。”
话音刚落，大日如来掌挟裹着七位英魂残存的愿力，轰然压向鸿钧。
掌势未至，那股金红交织的气息已如焚世烈焰，瞬间烧穿了鸿钧周身环绕的混沌气网，令其护身法则发出刺耳的崩裂之声。
与此同时，那道曾束缚鸿钧本源的暗金枷锁再次绽开新的裂痕，鸿蒙清气自裂缝中喷薄而出，卷起他鬓边如雪白发，丝丝缕缕皆在炽光中燃为灰烬，随风飘散。
鸿钧双目骤然一凝，竖瞳之中金光暴涨，仿佛有亿万星辰在其眼中生灭。
他抬手一引，混沌之气翻涌凝聚，瞬息间化作一幅玄奥莫测的混沌太极图，硬生生迎向那毁天灭地的一掌。
金红佛光与混沌本源猛烈相撞，刹那间，天地失声，万籁俱寂，唯有半页残破古录悬浮于虚空之中，其上字迹在金光映照下反复显形又隐没，似在诉说一段被刻意抹去的真相。
剧烈的能量对冲引发连绵不绝的破碎声，空间如琉璃般寸寸龟裂。
双方各自震退三步，鸿钧足下浮现出十二瓣幽深如墨的黑莲虚影，每一片莲瓣之上，皆蚀刻着一道被篡改、扭曲的天道律令，字字如咒，透出令人窒息的压迫感。
陈景言左袖在冲击中彻底碎裂，露出小臂上蜿蜒盘绕的青莲烙印——那是他与七人誓约的印记，亦是逆天之路的凭证。
鸿钧冷笑一声，指尖轻划过脚下黑莲虚影，十二道被篡改的律令竟如活物般游走升空，化作十二条墨色锁链，带着天罚般的威压，如毒蛇般缠向陈景言的四肢百骸，欲将其神魂彻底禁锢。
“陈日晚间，我早就告诉过你，”鸿钧语气森然，字字如刀，“凡敢质疑天道者，便是自寻死路。今日之劫，全是你咎由自取。”
陈景言目光如炬，直视鸿钧双眼，沉声问道：“你当真要死守这个早已腐朽溃烂的旧天？哪怕它早已背离公义，践踏众生？”
鸿钧神色凛然，信誓旦旦地回应：“天道法则，乃宇宙运行之根本，不容置疑，亦不可更改！此乃万物生成之基石、演化之纲纪，更是意识现象的终极根源。规则就是规则——亘古不变，万世不移！任何人，无论修为多高、意志多坚，都休想撼动分毫！”
陈景言忽然朗笑出声，那笑声如雷霆裂空，震得莲影在大日轮上层层漾开，仿佛整片虚空都被这笑声搅动，涟漪不断扩散至天边尽头。
他指着鸿钧说道：“你守的哪里是什么天道本原？不过是你自己亲手铸就、又甘愿困死其中的旧牢笼罢了！若天道真的不容生灵改命，那她们七个以魂燃道，不惜将毕生修为尽数融于我身，这难道不是天道自己所选的新路？不是命运悄然转向的契机？”
话音未落，他掌中大日轮骤然暴涨三千里，炽烈金红之光撕裂混沌，莲影顺着墨色锁链逆流而上，如火焰之蛇攀援天柱。
金红火油沿着锁链一路焚烧，所过之处，十二道天道律令如冰雪遇阳，遇火即融；那曾束缚万古、镇压诸天的墨色锁链，在烈焰中寸寸崩解，化作飞灰飘散于虚空之中。
：8xiaoshuo。：wap.8xiaoshuo
content_en:
Chen Jingyan did not shed tears.
He knew that shedding tears was a blasphemy against the trust they had entrusted with their lives.
He closed his eyes and concentrated, letting the sparks burn away the old self's body, old self's heart, and old self's thoughts.
When the last breath of the green lotus penetrated his heart, he slowly opened his eyes - there was no sadness or joy in his eyes, only a piece of pure fire of the green lotus that was as clear as ever, pure and untainted, illuminating the three thousand worlds.
All the cultivation, Tao, fruits, and wishes of the seven women were integrated into his body.
The meridians are like glass quenched, transparent and tough; the bones are like the rebirth of ancient jade, indestructible; the depths of the sea of ​​consciousness are deep.
The green lotus platform floats quietly, with a little lotus heart reflecting the three thousand worlds.
Each lotus petal condenses their unfinished traces and unquenched wishes, becoming the foundation of his new life.
Chen Jingyan slowly stood up, his eyes like torches, glaring at Hongjun angrily, the green lotus pure fire around him burned silently, and the heaven and earth were solemn.
Hongjun smiled slightly, and his tone was calm but with unquestionable majesty: "I have advised you many times to take your woman out of this world and stay away from this doomed fate. You insist on going against the will and stubbornness. Now that the seven souls are united, you have finally become a true 'chess player', but you have also completely cut off your escape route. Now, you can't leave even if you want to."
Chen Jingyan was silent for a moment, and his voice was low but firm as iron: "You want to kill me?"
"You overestimate your capabilities and insist on seeking your own death." Hongjun's voice was low and cold, as if coming from the eternal abyss, with an unquestionable sense of majesty and judgment.
Before Chen Jingyan finished speaking, a magnificent golden red sun wheel had already risen under Chen Jingyan's feet. The blazing light rushed out like a tide, instantly illuminating the entire collapsed sky.
The wheel rotates slowly, and the seven-petal lotus shadow on the edge spreads out one after another, layer upon layer, like a holy flower blooming in time.
Each lotus shadow pulls a sword intention that they condensed to the extreme during their lifetime - it is the immortal will left by the seven women who fought with their lives and forged swords with their souls.
The warm golden radiance is like the early spring sun, gently but firmly spreading through the cracks in time and space that have been fragmented, dispelling the remaining coldness and deathly silence in the void one by one.
Those silent bells that originally hung upside down above the nine heavens, symbolizing the imprisonment of heaven, melted inch by inch like ice and snow meeting fire under the radiance of this majestic brilliance, turning into hot copper water, gurgling along the gaps torn by the laws of heaven, and finally merged into the boundless nothingness, as if even the order of heaven and earth itself was quietly disintegrating.
Chen Jingyan slowly raised his right palm, his movement calm but containing great power.
With the gentle push of his palm, the golden-red sun wheel rolled forward, and the shadow of his palm continued to expand and extend in the void, eventually covering half of the sky and dyeing the entire sky into a warm and solemn golden red.
Wherever the wind of the palm passed, the remains of the broken stars that were still suspended in the air started to light up again. Every glimmer of light reflected the smiling face of a woman in the past - that was their unfulfilled wish and the whole reason that supported Chen Jingyan's defiance at this moment.
"They are not going against heaven," Chen Jingyan's voice was calm but every word was iron-clad, "but they want to seek justice that has been delayed for thousands of years. The old sky has long been decayed and should have been shattered long ago. And you, the gravekeeper, should also be buried with the long-dead old order."
As soon as he finished speaking, the Great Sun Tathagata held the remaining willpower of the seven heroic souls in his palm and pressed towards Hongjun.
Before the palm could reach, the golden and red aura was already like a burning flame, instantly burning through the chaotic air network surrounding Hongjun, causing his protective laws to make a harsh cracking sound.
At the same time, the dark golden shackles that once bound Hongjun's origin once again opened new cracks, and Hongmeng's pure energy spurted out from the cracks, rolling up his temples like snow-white hair, and the strands were burned to ashes in the blazing light and scattered in the wind.
Hongjun's eyes suddenly condensed, and the golden light in his vertical pupils skyrocketed, as if billions of stars were rising and dying in his eyes.
He raised his handAs soon as it was triggered, the energy of chaos surged and condensed, instantly turning into a mysterious Tai Chi diagram of chaos, forcefully facing the palm that destroyed the world.
The golden-red Buddha's light collided violently with the origin of chaos. In an instant, the heaven and earth lost all sound, and everything was silent. Only half a page of broken ancient records was suspended in the void. The writing on it appeared and disappeared repeatedly under the golden light, as if telling a truth that had been deliberately erased.
The violent energy conflict caused a continuous sound of shattering, and the space was cracked inch by inch like glass.
The two sides each took three steps back, and a twelve-petal black lotus as deep as ink appeared under Hongjun's feet. On each lotus petal, there was a tampered and twisted law of heaven etched on it. The words were like curses, giving off a suffocating sense of oppression.
Chen Jingyan's left sleeve was completely shattered by the impact, revealing the green lotus mark winding around his forearm - it was the mark of the oath he made with the seven people, and it was also the proof of the path to defy heaven.
Hongjun sneered, and lightly traced the black lotus shadow at his feet with his fingertips. The twelve tampered laws actually floated into the sky like living creatures, turning into twelve ink-colored chains. With the pressure of heavenly punishment, they entangled Chen Jingyan's limbs and bones like poisonous snakes, trying to completely imprison his soul.
"Chen Riwan, I told you a long time ago," Hongjun said in a serious tone, every word like a knife, "Anyone who dares to question the way of heaven is seeking death. Today's disaster is all your own fault."
Chen Jingyan looked directly into Hongjun's eyes, and asked in a deep voice, "Do you really want to cling to this rotten old world? Even if it has already betrayed justice and trampled on all living beings?"
Hongjun looked solemn and responded swornly: "The laws of heaven are the foundation of the operation of the universe. They cannot be doubted or changed! This is the cornerstone of the creation of all things, the order of evolution, and the ultimate source of consciousness. Rules are rules - eternal and unchangeable! No one, no matter how high their cultivation level or how strong their will, can even think of shaking it!"
Chen Jingyan suddenly laughed loudly. The laughter cracked the sky like thunder, causing the lotus shadows to ripple on the big sun wheel. It was as if the entire void was stirred by the laughter, and the ripples continued to spread to the end of the horizon.
He pointed at Hongjun and said: "Where is the origin of Heaven's Dao that you are guarding? It's just an old cage that you have built with your own hands and are willing to be trapped in! If Heaven's Dao really does not allow living beings to change their fate, then the seven of them burned the Dao with their souls and did not hesitate to integrate all their life-long cultivation into me. Isn't this the new path chosen by Heaven's Dao itself? Isn't it an opportunity for fate to quietly turn?"
Before he finished speaking, the big sun wheel in his palm suddenly skyrocketed three thousand miles, and the blazing golden-red light tore through the chaos. The lotus shadow followed the ink-colored chain upstream, like a flaming snake climbing up the sky pillar.
The golden red fire oil burned along the chain, and where it passed, the twelve heavenly laws melted like ice and snow meeting the sun, and melted when meeting the fire; the ink-colored chain that had bound the eternity and suppressed the heavens disintegrated inch by inch in the flames, turning into fly ash and floating in the void.
